content: GPS spoofing on attendance apps: most free spoofer apps trip Android's Settings.Secure.ALLOW_MOCK_LOCATION flag (catches ~60-80% of casual attempts) but rooted/Magisk-modded devices can hide the mock flag entirely via Xposed modules. Effective layered detection: mock-location flag, root/emulator detection (su binary, Magisk fingerprint), physics-based checks (impossible speed/teleport jumps, GPS accuracy that's suspiciously perfect/constant vs real noisy GPS). No client-side check is unbeatable against a determined technically capable user; treat GPS+photo as fraud deterrence/evidence, not cryptographic proof.
